text_block_list.text: One day, after finishing the race with Maruzensky and things had settled down—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I'm going to create a brand new training course!
choice_data_list: Like the obstacle course from before...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...I failed back then.
I was so desperate to catch up with everyone that I just kept pushing myself too hard."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's different now!
Because being ordinary is my very "strength"!

Her eyes were dead serious.
...She is still single-mindedly seeking strength.
choice_data_list: Okay, let's give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I did it...! Thank you so much!
I'll see it through to completion, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What we're making is a cross-country course!
Running right through nature, like woods and sandy beaches!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If we make full use of all the terrain on this island,
it'll definitely become the ultimate course!
choice_data_list: I see, this looks like it’s going to be quite the undertaking…!
I see, this looks like it’s going to be a lot of work…!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely worth that much!
Let's do this, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
All right. Rotting log cleared and done!
choice_data_list: We're done leveling the ground on this side too...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
...There's still a long way to go, but I'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Every island starts as an uninhabited island"!
Even if you're ordinary, slow and steady will get you across the finish line!
—Good work, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Ardan-san and Yaeno-san!?
What are you two doing here...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were working hard on designing the course.
I'd be glad to help, if only in a small way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We've honed each other's skills, and...
I want to keep competing with you with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yes.
I look forward to working with you too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Such a huge boulder.
It must be dangerous to carry it all by yourself...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hm, heavens...! In that case, I shall shatter it into smaller pieces. Kongou Yaegaki-ryuu Secret Art—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait~!
I think it would be safer if we all worked together!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We have hemp sacks, so let's use those!
We put the rock on top, and then everyone grabs a corner to carry it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Goodness... I'm astonished.
To think you could carry it so easily...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, if it's something like this,
it happened all the time during the uninhabited island project.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you ever have any other trouble, just let me know!
I'm sure I can be of help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Chiyono O-san...
Yes, that is very reassuring. Truly.
For the next few days, Sakura Chiyono O and the others worked on building the new course, and then—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah—with this... I've finished...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Running on all kinds of terrain...
To think it would work the entire body this much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
However... a strange sense of calm washes over me...
Perhaps it is because we are surrounded by nature...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
This is our course...!
Fufu...♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
We did it... It's finally complete!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Your hard work has borne fruit.
Yeah! Your hard work has finally paid off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, it wasn't just my own strength!
Yaeno-san, Ardan-san, and also—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer.
...Because you were the one who taught me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Building upon ordinary things.
She taught me that's something to be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because you were there for me, Trainer...
I was able to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "So, you see... Actually, I got a brand new Chiyo Notebook."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The old one's completely filled up. So I figured I'd start fresh with this notebook.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, so...
Well, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep filling out the Chiyo Notebook...
with you, from here on out...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
! ...Ehehe♪
I'm counting on you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What will be written on these blank, white pages...?
I'm so excited!
